_comment: Reference values for qe-ecutwfc-convergence (QE 7.4 conda-forge build hac89879_0, PBE, Si diamond 2-atom cell celldm(1)=10.26, ecutrho fixed 480 Ry, 4x4x4 shifted MP grid, conv_thr 1e-10). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: 5 calibration runs (probe + 4 more) produced identical energies at the 1e-8 Ry print resolution (spread 0), 8-9 SCF iterations per point, ~3-6 s per run. Per-atom deltas: 20->30 = 12.2 meV (>1), 30->40 = 0.82 meV (<1), 40->50 = 0.62 meV, 50->60 = 0.13 meV — converged cutoff 40 Ry with a comfortable margin on both sides of the criterion. Tolerance 1e-5 Ry = physical print-resolution floor; L4 recompute of the ecut=20 point must match the agent log to 1e-6 Ry.
